pictures.author: ASartan
pictures.observations: Complete960x643 exterior: roofless portico bounded by heavy flat architraves/cavetto cornice, varied open palm/bell and closed bud capitals, low screen walls/taller central doorframe. Roofed lower stone rear body has cavetto top, side doorway and horizontal small square socket/recess row. Occupied stone platform/narrow approach. Original simplified vocabulary, no copied relief pixels.

pictures.author: Roland Unger
pictures.observations: Complete800x530 east-side view resolves central open rectangular doorframe below the unroofed column/beam portico and lower rear body. Temporary restoration scaffolding omitted; this dated view is not a claim about current restoration state.

pictures.author: Roland Unger
pictures.observations: Complete800x533 south side resolves four exterior supports along the portico depth, low screens/side entrance gap, flat beams with cavetto top, varied flared/bud capitals and lower rear wall socket row. Short broad treads follow occupied platform. Exact hidden interior support/room inventory is not established.

pictures.author: NYU Excavations at Amheida Staff / Institute for the Study of the Ancient World
pictures.observations: Complete500x667 separate limestone entrance gateway: thick square jambs/true rectangular passage, broad lintel/cavetto head/torus bands and winged-disc silhouette. Worn block joints/fragments. Use original simple sun/wing geometry, no traced relief or copied photo atlas. Which exact gate on the approach is not resolved by the map; allocation near the eastern reference point remains approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Hibis temple exterior: lower roofed stone rear body with cavetto cornice, actual front/side doorways and shallow square wall sockets; higher roofless portico with varied palm/bell/bud capitals, heavy perimeter beams, low screen walls and central open doorframe. Occupied platform/short approaches and one pictured freestanding carved entrance gateway. Original simplified bands/petals/winged-disc vocabulary over shared sandstone, no copied inscriptions/relief atlas. Internal support/room inventory, other distant gates/quay, palms, precinct walls and temporary scaffold are not claimed authored.
